summary: BHP Group filed a Form 6-K furnishing an exchange release dated 12 November 2026 announcing the appointment of Adrian Wood as Chief Financial Officer effective 17 February 2027, succeeding Vandita Pant, who steps down after the half-year results on 16 February 2027 and remains for transition support until 29 March 2027. CEO Brandon Craig endorsed the appointment; the release cites Wood's finance and commercial background, including prior VP Finance and Group Investor Relations roles. This is a planned, orderly succession rather than an abrupt departure; no financial terms or advisor named. Watch for continuity in capital-allocation discipline and any strategic implications.
